PLAN "Postpartum 12-week return (C-section, 4 weeks postpartum) + Breastfeeding nutrition + Progressive strength + Core reintroduction + Phase 3 intensity + Cardio + HIIT guidance"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Progressive postpartum recovery and return to strength"
  GOAL secondary nutrition:
    name "Support breastfeeding with balanced nutrition and hydration"
  GOAL tertiary core:
    name "Safe phased reintroduction of abdominal exercise post C-section"
  GOAL quaternary power:
    name "Build strength and confidence to feel strong by week 12"
  GOAL quinary cardio:
    name "Progressive low-impact cardio for conditioning and recovery"
  GOAL senary hiit:
    name "Introduce low-impact HIIT safely once medical clearance and tolerance achieved"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Early recovery (weeks 1-2) — walking only, gentle" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Gentle mobility & walk":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x5 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 3x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          marching 3x30..60 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Walk + gentle core re-education":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 4x5 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x6 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 3x6 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          standing_forward_fold 2x30..60 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Mobility and glute activation + walk":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x30..60 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Progressive walk + activation":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 4x5 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          marching 3x60..90 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Gentle movement flow + short brisk walk":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 4x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Strength foundations (bodyweight) + walk":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 4x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          split_squat 3x6 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x10..20 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          scapular_retraction 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2: Reconditioning (weeks 3-6) — build tolerance, low-impact conditioning" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walk + mobility (steady walk)":

          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 4x5 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Lower body control + brisk walk intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Core & posture + moderate walk":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 4x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x10..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 4x5 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walk + strength (steady walk)":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 4x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Functional lower body + walk/jog checks":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          good_morning 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Core progression + longer moderate walk":

          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 4x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          plank 3x30..40 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds

          diaphragmatic_breathing 4x5 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:

    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Walk + mobility (brisk segments)":

          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 4x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          hip_abduction 4x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds

        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Strength endurance + brisk walking intervals":

          walking 12m

          squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Core & posture + easy cycling alternative":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x20 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 4x5 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Walk + progressive strength (steady + intervals)":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          hip_abduction 4x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Unilateral strength + cardio mix":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Core resilience + steady cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 4x12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          plank 3x40..60 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x25 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 4x5 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

        cooldown:

        cooldown:

        cooldown:
